payload.title: Use the number pad for workspace movement and consolidation with a built-in guide

expectation.text: Number-pad shortcuts should move windows, protect selected workspaces from consolidation, consolidate workspaces across one or all monitors, and open an explanatory native guide.

payload.observed: The custom Numpad Shortcuts plugin expanded beyond workspace selection to provide those optional actions and a guide. This is a personal workflow extension, not behavior Omarchy previously promised.
